title: Vintage & Exotics MV Agusta Brutale 1000 RR
description: Representing MV Agusta's prowess in the Middleweight Sportbike class, the MV Agusta Vintage & Exotics MV Agusta Brutale 1000 RR is delivers razor-sharp chassis feedback for riders hunting apexes. A 1000cc powerplant pumps out 150 HP and 120 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
